'''Operation Blackout''' was undertaken by the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
[[Republic Strategic Information Service]] undercover agent [[Prellon Garn]] obtained information about the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|''Gauntlet'' superweapon]] and needed to deliver it to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. He was cornered by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] General [[Elin Garza]] sent the [[Havoc Squad]] to ensure his safety. After meeting Agent [[Jonas Balkar]] in [[Anchorhead Spaceport]], [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Havoc Squad Lieutenant]] proceeded to Garn's location in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] and eliminated the Imperial forces that had cornered him.<ref name="TOR" />
